facts.fact: DR Congo's foreign minister said on 26 November 2026 that the ministry's Digital Master Plan 2026-2028, launched 18 June 2026 with EU support, puts data control and digital autonomy at the centre and requires securing data, per ACP.

COD.note: A ministry's own plan, no rule, hosting or contract terms stated.

systems.country_label: Foreign ministry digital master plan 2026-2028 (27 initiatives, four axes)

COD.note: A ministry's own plan, not the whole government's strategy.
